name: Ammonius
bio: Ammonius is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors records the poet's date as unknown.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 827).

poems.title: Book IX, 827: On the Same
poems.author: Ammonius
poems.text: I am the dear servant of horned Dionysus, and pour forth the water of the silver Naiads, soothing the young boy who rests asleep . . .
